Rewritten from rst2023_wa_session_intro, which Meta approved as MARKETING.
Marketing templates are subject to per-user limits and opt-outs, so they
deliver less reliably. This copy drops the promotional framing ('sneak peek
into something special') for a plain statement of what the participant is
registered for and what will arrive, which reads as UTILITY. Meta assigns
the final category and may still disagree.
